title: 差分隐私如何影响大语言模型的社会偏见？一项系统评估
summary: 本文系统评估了差分隐私（DP）对预训练LLM中社会偏见的影响。研究发现DP在句子评分任务中能减少偏见，但这种改善不能泛化到所有任务。结果揭示了logit级偏见与输出级偏见之间的差异，且减少记忆并不一定能降低不公平性，强调了评估公平性时多范式评估的重要性。
summary_en: This paper systematically evaluates how differential privacy (DP) affects social bias in pretrained LLMs. It finds that DP reduces bias in sentence scoring tasks but this improvement does not generalize across all tasks, revealing a discrepancy between logit-level and output-level bias and underscoring the need for multi-paradigm evaluation.
